name: vita-ayuda-software2
description: Plataforma de seguimiento de pacientes — Vita Ayuda

scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@vita-ayuda/shared && npm run build --workspace=@vita-ayuda/config && npm run build --workspace=@vita-ayuda/database
scripts.dev: npm run setup:env && npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n backend,frontend "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=apps/backend && npm run build --workspace=apps/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run db:generate && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
